candidates.title: Cochise Stronghold Rock Fellow Dome FPV
candidates.desc: Another trip out to the Stronghold, man a lot went into making this one... A brutal two hour hike up crazy steep trail, to discover a surreal vista. A carefully planned line and some luck and my drone returned safely. Still haven't been able to  get up to dive the front side of Rock Fellow Dome, nee

Also see  https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies  for tips on effectively exporting YouTube cookies
